note: Curated organizational families for the directory UI. A family groups published sites whose own curated descriptions (tools/overlay.json, each backed by verifiedBasis source reads at a recorded SHA) document work on the same named project or competition. Grouping is a reading aid only: it asserts nothing about a site's quality, behavior, liveness, or results, and it never overrides a site's category or flags. Membership is curated per repository — never inferred from a repository name alone. Repositories whose README documents no purpose (neutral placeholders) are deliberately left ungrouped. Regenerate the derived view with tools/build_data.py; do not hand-edit data/sites.js.

families.label: DOE GEMS Prize Challenge lanes
families.summary: Independent research and submission lanes for the DrivenData DOE GEMS Prize Challenge (geothermal fault prediction in the GeoDAWN / Great Basin region). Each lane publishes its own candidates, evidence and verdicts; the directory reports each repository's own claims without validating them. Title-only placeholder repositories document no purpose and are deliberately not grouped here.
families.basis: Membership is curated from each member's own README at the SHA recorded in its verifiedBasis: every member description documents DOE GEMS Prize Challenge work (lanes, submissions, fault-discovery research, forks/copies of a GEMS lane with a new strategy, or a research library for the competition). Sources are per entry in VERIFICATION.md and data/sites/. 62GEMSDOE is excluded because its README is a title-only placeholder (see IRR register and its entry).
